bear: September inflation came in hot at 3.7%, and producer prices jumped 1.3% in a single month
Oil spiked over 10% in a week to about $101, raising costs for companies and consumers
Concerns about how AI data centers are being financed, led by CoreWeave's debt, spread across tech
Higher bond yields make stocks less attractive by comparison
bull: The index is only about 2% below its all-time high
Odds of a Fed rate hike in October reportedly fell below 15%
Big companies like Goldman Sachs and TSMC beat expectations
Stocks bounced back on Oct 19 as investors bought the dip in AI names
briefs.headline: Pulled back from its record as inflation, oil and AI worries hit
briefs.name: S&P 500
briefs.nextEvent: Fed meeting on October 27-28, plus earnings from Microsoft, Amazon and Apple

sources.title: Stock market outlook for the week of 19-23 October 2026

briefs.summary: The S&P 500 fell 1.9% in the week ending Oct 16 to 7,659, below its Oct 6 record close of 7,819. Hot inflation (CPI up 3.7% from a year ago), oil above $100 after attacks near the Strait of Hormuz, and worries about debt-funded AI spending all weighed on stocks. Big earnings reports and the Fed meeting on Oct 27-28 are the next tests.

bear: The index broke its uptrend line that started at the April low
Investors are questioning whether AI spending will earn enough to justify the debt behind it
Chip stocks fell sharply worldwide, with South Korea's market hitting circuit breakers
High oil prices, hot inflation and rising bond yields hit growth stocks the hardest
bull: The selloff left tech oversold, and buyers stepped in quickly on Oct 19
Citigroup estimates AI could drive nearly 70% of global corporate earnings growth next year
Big AI deals keep coming, like reported talks for about $45B of computing power for Anthropic
Momentum indicators show the selling is slowing down
briefs.headline: Worst week since June for tech, then a partial bounce
briefs.name: Nasdaq
briefs.nextEvent: Tech earnings over the next two weeks, starting with Microsoft on October 27

sources.title: Chart of the day: US100 (Nasdaq 100) rebound in AI trade vs weakening technical picture

briefs.summary: The Nasdaq Composite fell 4.5% in the week ending Oct 16, its worst week since June, as chip stocks sold off hard (the semiconductor index dropped about 11%). It bounced 1.1% on Oct 19 as investors bought beaten-down AI stocks, but analysts called it a rebound inside a correction, not a return to the uptrend.

bear: Guidance of 9 to 11% growth came in below the roughly 12% analysts expected
Tariff refunds added about $0.11 to EPS, so part of the beat won't repeat
At about 39x earnings, a lot of good news is already priced in
UBS, KeyBanc and MoffettNathanson are cautious, with targets from $250 to $304
bull: Fiscal Q3 revenue rose 16% to $109.4B and EPS of $2.02 beat the $1.89 estimate
iPhone revenue grew about 22% and Services grew 12%, with gross margin above 50%
Evercore ($380), Bank of America ($370), Citi ($365) and TD Cowen ($400) all raised or hold high targets
New AI-enabled products, including a foldable iPhone, could drive another upgrade cycle
briefs.headline: Record results, but analysts are split on how much upside is left

sources.title: Apple stock forecast: Wall Street analysts split on AAPL's upside

briefs.summary: Apple beat expectations last quarter on strong iPhone sales and closed near its 52-week high around $343 (Oct 16). Most analysts still rate it a Buy and several raised targets, but the average target now sits slightly below the share price, guidance came in under expectations, and the stock trades at about 39 times earnings.

bear: Trailing 12-month free cash flow was -$7.6B, versus +$18.2B a year earlier
Equipment purchases rose $66.1B, mostly for AI
Traders question whether this level of AI spending is sustainable, which drove a selloff the week before
bull: AWS sales rose 37% to $42.2B in Q2 2026
Total sales grew 20% to $200.6B and operating income rose to $27.5B from $19.2B
Morgan Stanley revised its view on the stock and AI-linked shares rebounded
briefs.headline: AWS is booming, but AI spending has turned cash flow negative

sources.title: Amazon Stock News (Oct 20, 2026): AMZN Rises 5.0% to $262.45

briefs.summary: Amazon jumped 5% to $262.45 on Oct 19 after a Morgan Stanley note and a rebound in AI stocks. AWS cloud sales are growing 37% a year and operating income is way up. The catch is that Amazon is spending so much on AI data centers that its free cash flow over the last year was negative.

bear: EPS missed estimates even after excluding the securities loss
Fixed-income trading fell 4% and investment banking fees dropped 8% from last quarter
Expenses rose 12% and loan-loss provisions were $2.7B
Analyst targets were set before the miss and could come down
bull: Revenue rose 8% to $50.2B and average loans grew 10%
Return on tangible equity of 20% and a strong 13.9% capital ratio
2027 forecast implies about 10% growth in net interest income
Trades around 14x earnings; Barclays ($420) and Bank of America ($400) rate it a Buy
briefs.headline: First earnings miss since 2023, but the bank is still very profitable

sources.title: JPMorgan Chase stock forecast after earnings miss

briefs.summary: JPMorgan earned $5.57 per share in Q3, short of the $5.85 estimate, partly due to a $658M securities loss. Shares traded near $336 on Oct 13. Lending and consumer banking are growing steadily and returns are strong, but weaker bond trading, rising expenses and higher loan-loss provisions worry some analysts.

bear: About $175B of capital spending planned for 2026 could lower operating margins
Heavy spending has already reduced free cash flow
Azure growth below the roughly 45% guide would disappoint; recent earnings moves ranged from -9.8% to +14.7%
bull: Management says customer demand still exceeds available capacity
Cloud revenue passed $214B in fiscal 2026, nearly two-thirds of total revenue
Microsoft 365 cloud growth is expected to speed up as usage-based AI billing is added
briefs.headline: Earnings on Oct 27 will test the Azure growth story

sources.title: Which Dates Could Move Microsoft Stock Most?

briefs.summary: Microsoft has rallied about 34% over three months on cloud and AI demand that management says still exceeds capacity. The next earnings report is the key test: investors expect Azure growth of about 45%. The concern is the enormous amount being spent on data centers, which is squeezing free cash flow and may lower margins.

bear: The outlook assumes zero data center revenue from China
The 10-year Treasury yield near 5.1% is a headwind for high-valued tech stocks
Doubts about how customers will finance AI spending caused a sharp chip selloff in mid-October
bull: Q2 revenue was $96.2B, up 106% from a year ago; data center revenue rose 117%
Gross margin of 75% shows strong pricing power
The Vera Rubin platform is entering full production and CEO Jensen Huang says demand is accelerating
briefs.headline: Growth is still huge, but the AI trade got shaky this month
briefs.nextEvent: Big customers (Meta, Microsoft, Amazon) report earnings this week and next; their AI spending plans move Nvidia

sources.title: Nvidia Stock News (Oct 20, 2026): NVDA Rises 1.4% to $217.09

briefs.summary: Nvidia's last quarter more than doubled revenue, and management says demand is accelerating as its new Vera Rubin chips ramp up. The stock bounced to about $217 on Oct 19 after a week-long AI chip selloff, leaving it about 11% below its 52-week high. The worries are about how the AI buildout gets paid for, rising interest rates, and China.

bear: Operating income fell 56% to $718M and operating margin dropped to 2.6%
R&D spending rose 69% as Tesla funds AI and robotics
Energy revenue fell 16% and storage deployments missed estimates
Regulatory credit revenue fell 73%, removing an easy source of profit
bull: Deliveries of 486,532 beat estimates by over 24,000 vehicles
Gross margin rose to 19.6% from 16.8% last quarter
Free cash flow was +$1.53B, after -$1.09B in Q2
Active Full Self-Driving subscriptions grew 67% to 1.74M
briefs.headline: Q3 beat on profit and margins, but operating income fell by more than half
briefs.nextEvent: Watch Q4 delivery numbers in early January
briefs.summary: Tesla reported Q3 results on Oct 21. Revenue was flat at $28.05B, adjusted EPS of $0.48 beat the $0.45 estimate, margins improved and free cash flow turned positive. But spending on AI, robotaxis and the Optimus robot pushed operating income down 56%, and energy storage missed expectations.
